S.FORM: alang Kin'lwan ga niya mki sku Toweng si atu Hosing Ku, kwara sali buwan nya ga 21 buwan, 66 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 95% kyan ku 63 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspung Gyencumin ga 5% kyan ku 3 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Tayan 95%. maki qu ngasal bziran. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na Kin'lwan hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay 'zil na Kin'lwan hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkyahu' na Kin'lwan hya' ga llyung. tay mkraya' na Kin'lwan hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkyahu' na Kin'lwan hya' ga Hbun-sinqumi. tay 'zil na Kin'lwan hya' ga Pyasan. rekisi kayal kyokay ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ kinʔlwan ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku toweŋ [s|ɕ]i atu ħo[s|ɕ]iŋ ku kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa ** βuwan ** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku ** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]puŋ ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa * kjan ku * ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa tajan ** maki qu ŋa[s|ɕ]al βziran rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na kinʔlwan ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj ʔzil na kinʔlwan ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkjaħuʔ na kinʔlwan ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkrajaʔ na kinʔlwan ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkjaħuʔ na kinʔlwan ħjaʔ ɣa ħβun[s|ɕ]inqumi taj ʔzil na kinʔlwan ħjaʔ ɣa pja[s|ɕ]an reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
